seo.title: Grey & Ductile Iron Castings Supplier India – ASTM A48 / A536 | Asian Technocast
seo.description: Iron foundry in Rajkot, India, since 2006. Motor frames, end shields, pump casings, gearbox housings, machined in-house and exported FOB/CIF. Send your drawing for a quote.

headline: Grey & ductile iron castings, machined in-house, exported from India.
subhead: Motor frames, end shields, pump casings and gearbox housings made to your drawing in ASTM A48 and A536 grades. Shipped FOB or CIF from Mundra or Pipavav.

why.title: One supplier: casting + machining
why.text: Casting, CNC/VMC machining and painting under one roof, so you get finished parts with one point of contact.

why.title: Grades you specify
why.text: We work to ASTM A48 and A536, with IS and EN equivalents cross-referenced for your drawing.

why.title: Documented quality
why.text: Material test certificates and dimensional reports, with first-article inspection or PPAP on request.

why.title: Export-ready packing
why.text: ISPM-15 heat-treated wooden crates and pallets, shipped FOB or CIF from Gujarat ports.

why.title: Direct contact with the owners
why.text: You talk to the people who run the foundry, by email, phone or WhatsApp.

why.title: Fast replies
why.text: We reply within 24 hours (IST); our evening overlaps US morning hours.

ctaTitle: Send your drawing for a quote
ctaText: PDF, STEP, DWG or DXF. Tell us the grade, annual quantity and delivery target, and we will reply within 24 hours (IST).
